title: Game (engine project)

godot.scaffold: Godot editor > New Project (GDScript); tests with GUT (addons/gut) or tests/run_tests.gd

unity.scaffold: Unity Hub > New project; tests with the Unity Test Framework (Window > General > Test Runner)

unreal.scaffold: Epic Games Launcher > Unreal Engine > New Project; automation tests via Session Frontend

S0.run: headless unit tests: GUT for Godot, Unity Test Framework edit mode, Unreal automation (-nullrhi)

S1.how: godot --headless in a container (devcontainer or barichello/godot-ci); GameCI Unity images (unityci/editor) with your licence

S2.how: play-mode / scene tests with a real renderer on this machine (GPU); input automation

S3.how: GitHub Actions: chickensoft-games/setup-godot, GameCI unity-test-runner (licence secrets); Unreal needs a self-hosted runner with the engine

release: export presets and export templates match the engine version (Godot: export_presets.cfg in git)
per-store builds: Steam (depots, branches), itch.io (butler), consoles need dev kits and certification
age rating (IARC), store page assets, controller support declared

godot.outdated: compare config/features in project.godot with https://godotengine.org/download; addons: check each addon repo
godot.upgrade_safe: patch release of the same minor (4.x.y): open in the new editor, commit the re-import
godot.upgrade_major: back up, open in the new editor and let it convert; Godot 3 → 4 uses the project converter

unity.outdated: Unity Hub shows newer LTS editors; Package Manager > Updates
unity.upgrade_major: new LTS stream in a branch; run the API Updater, fix obsolete APIs

rollback: No store rollback button: re-publish the previous build. Steam: set the previous build live on the default branch. itch.io: butler push the old build. Keep every release build archived.
observe: crash reports (Sentry for Godot or Unity, Unreal Crash Reporter)
frame time / FPS on the lowest target hardware

policies.what: Unity Runtime Fee was cancelled (2024-09); Unity 6 Personal is free up to the revenue limit in the current terms. Check the licence tier before release.
